# [guard / specialization / compiled-artifact cache] warm-cache result differs from a cold compile when `dtype` changes

changing 'dtype' did not trigger a recompile, yet the warm result differs from a cold compile of the same context: the cached artifact was reused under assumptions that no longer hold

## Accuracy methodology
